question: What is the name of the book written by Shri Amitabh Kant about India's G20 Presidency and Summit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**How India Scaled Mt G20.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi lauds Amitabh Kant’s book on India’s G20 Presidency and Summit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book is titled 'How India Scaled Mt G20.'**
 
• The book highlights the rigorous process behind the New Delhi Leader's Declaration for the G20 summit, including 16 failed drafts.
 
• The book details the 300 hours of discussions and 11 sleepless nights required to finalize the declaration.
 
• PM Modi praised the book for providing a lucid perspective on India’s human-centric development efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Amitabh Kant__

 
 
• Former CEO of NITI Aayog
 
• Played a key role in India’s G20 Presidency
 
• Author of 'How India Scaled Mt G20'
